description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, causes [Imperil Prismatic 10% (15s)]/[Imperil Prismatic 30% (15s)] if 0-3/4+ Type-0 allies are alive, grants [Attach Dark with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Dual Awoken Darkness Mode I (Sice)] to the user, grants [Type-0 Resonance +3% Boost] to all Type-0 allies

description.name: Dual Awoken Darkness Mode I (Sice)
description.text: Darkness abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Darkness abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00/x2.50/x3.00 for equipped Darkness abilities after casting 1/2/3+ Darkness abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Darkness Mode II (Sice)], removes [Dual Awoken Darkness Mode I (Sice)], grants [ATK, DEF, MAG and RES +30% (25s)] to all allies

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Darkness Mode II (Sice)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap by 20000, Darkness abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Darkness abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Dual Nemesis Force after using Darkness abilities

description.name: Dual Nemesis Force
description.text: One single attack (2.64) capped at 99999, 100% hit rate

description.name: Imperil Prismatic 10% (15s)
description.text: Causes [Imperil Fire 10% (15s)], [Imperil Ice 10% (15s)], [Imperil Lightning 10% (15s)], [Imperil Earth 10% (15s)], [Imperil Wind 10% (15s)], [Imperil Water 10% (15s)], [Imperil Holy 10% (15s)], [Imperil Dark 10% (15s)] and [Imperil Poison 10% (15s)]

description.name: Imperil Prismatic 30% (15s)
description.text: Causes [Imperil Fire 30% (15s)], [Imperil Ice 30% (15s)], [Imperil Lightning 30% (15s)], [Imperil Earth 30% (15s)], [Imperil Wind 30% (15s)], [Imperil Water 30% (15s)], [Imperil Holy 30% (15s)], [Imperil Dark 30% (15s)] and [Imperil Poison 30% (15s)]

description.name: Attach Dark with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Dark Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Dark 3

description.name: Type-0 Resonance +3% Boost
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 3% if the character's Realm is Type-0
